title: SectionViewStyle group-3 resource-reference insertion fast slice
scope: Serialize a changed SectionViewStyle view-label text-style reference when its group-3 group-340 source field is absent.
Preserve ordered groups and aligned ASCII raw lexemes/Binary placeholders.
Verify typed same-version ASCII and Binary readback without adding repository fixtures or a CTest registration.

implementation.behavior: The copied SectionViewStyle raw carrier inserts group 340 in style group 3 when the typed view-label text-style handle differs from the class default and no source group represented it. Handle text is rendered as checked hexadecimal; zero and sentinel handles are refused. ASCII raw lexemes and Binary placeholders remain aligned, and the raw-object writer applies its existing source-handle remapping.
implementation.generatedControl: The generated SectionViewStyle retains other group-3 fields but omits the group-340 reference. The test confirms the imported typed handle is zero, edits it to the existing VIEW_STYLE_TEXT style, verifies exact ordered groups in ASCII and Binary, and checks typed readback resolves to that style.

limitations: Only same-version DXF serialization of this optional single-reference field is covered.
Other absent fields and changed repeated-reference cardinality remain fail-closed.
No DWG-origin typed output, cross-version translation, native style rendering, or consumer support qualification follows.
